richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Nagpur

c: Nagpur summers are among the hottest in India, and anyone planning an outdoor gym in the city should start with shade. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Nagpur for the Nagpur Municipal Corporation's gardens, housing societies, schools, colleges and the lakeside walking tracks at places like Futala and Ambazari. We build every machine at our Vasai factory, about 670 km away.

Machines reach Nagpur by road within Maharashtra, and our installation team or a dealer in western India fixes them on site. Nagpur's heat peaks in May. The monsoon follows from June to September, and winters are short and pleasant. People here walk early and late, so a gym under existing trees, or under a pergola from our garden decor range, will be used year round.

items.q: How do we keep an outdoor gym usable in Nagpur's summer?
items.a: Place it under trees or a shade structure and encourage use at dawn and after sunset. Light paving underfoot also stays cooler than dark stone.

items.q: Is an 8 Station Multi Gym suitable for a school ground?
items.a: Yes, if there is enough clear space around it. One teacher can supervise a full group on a single frame. We mark the clear space on the layout drawing.

items.q: Do you install in Nagpur and the rest of Vidarbha?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer, using the grouting or self-standing method that suits the site.
